Name: Simple Washed Valley
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌿 Simple Washed Valley[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][i]It looks washed. I don’t really know why I made this mod, but here we are.[/i][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]A softer world recolor with sage greens, cool slate, warm timber and quieter seasonal colours, using Stardew Valley’s original artwork.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Turn it on with Alt + 2[/b], or choose [b]Washed[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu. The starting preset is Vanilla.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54136/54136-1792352528-862050338.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#86EFAC]🍃 A Washed Valley[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Buildings, terrain, trees, grass, fences, paths and world decorations receive a softer palette. Seasonal artwork includes spring, summer, autumn and winter, with scenery for the beach, desert, Ginger Island, interiors and caves.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Original pixel shapes and texture details remain. Characters, portraits, menus, inventory items, player furniture and crops are outside this world recolor.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54136/54136-1792352531-414522144.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🏪 Pierre’s Shop Sign[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Pierre’s sign uses a muted slate frame and clearer cream lettering across all seasons and localized sign artwork.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54136/54136-1792358810-1061945635.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]⚙ Switching the Palette[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Alt + 1:[/b] open this mod’s settings (requires Generic Mod Config Menu).
[b]Alt + 2 / Alt + 3:[/b] switch between Vanilla and Washed.
The keys can be reassigned. Your chosen preset is saved.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires Stardew Valley for PC and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]. The recolor targets the original PC 1.6.15 artwork. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.
Extract [b]SimpleWashedValley[/b] into your Mods folder, then select Washed. Content Patcher is not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Custom replacement textures are left unchanged when they differ from the supported original artwork. Combining world recolors may therefore produce a mixed appearance; use one world recolor at a time. Disable Simple World Themes when using this standalone mod to avoid overlapping textures and default hotkeys.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Comparison images use controlled native-render scenes. They are not screenshots from a played save.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]For bugs, include the mod, game and SMAPI versions, your platform, what happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce. Add a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url] and a screenshot if helpful.
For suggestions, tell me what you would like changed and how it would improve the recolor.[/color][/size][/center]
